_bootstrap_comment: Reduced from 1000 → 200 (D10) after observing that the test set has 1.98M rows: 1000 iters × 6 scenarios (3 models × 2 thresholds) × 5 metrics over 1.98M samples projected 60-90 min of bootstrap. 200 iters give a 95% percentile CI with more than enough statistical resolution.
_subsample_comment: Size of the stratified subsample used ONLY for the hyperparameter search in Phase 3 (decision D8). The final model is refitted on the full train (~7.9M).

window_dates._comment: Computed in Phase 1 from min/max of sent_at over the full dataset (messages.csv.gz). See decisions D1 and D5.
